Aspera Connect — install (2 files)
================================

PC (Linux Mint / Ubuntu)
  1. Download: AsperaConnect-Desktop.deb
  2. Double-click it → Install (or: sudo apt install ./AsperaConnect-Desktop.deb)
  3. Open "Aspera Connect" from the app menu

Phone (Android)
  1. Download: AsperaConnect-Phone.apk  (open link on the phone)
  2. If Google Play Protect says "App blocked" → see TROUBLESHOOTING.txt
     (or IT: adb install -r AsperaConnect-Phone.apk)
  3. Open app → allow permissions

Connect (WhatsApp-style — works across networks)
  1. Company runs the free cloud relay once (see apps/relay/README.md)
  2. PC: Phone calls → Show QR to pair
  3. Phone: Scan PC QR
  4. Done — works even if phone Wi-Fi ≠ PC LAN

Same-network fallback (no relay): enter phone IP → Connect

Something wrong?  See TROUBLESHOOTING.txt

That's it.
